articles.title: Barrenetxea no entrena a dos días del Bernabéu, pero Gorrotxategi y Guedes sí
articles.standfirst: El 7 tuvo que ser sustituido el viernes en La Cartuja y es duda para el partido del miércoles, que habrá que ver si, como el del Betis, también les llega pronto al 11 y al 4
articles.summary: El 7 tuvo que ser sustituido el viernes en La Cartuja y es duda para el partido del miércoles, que habrá que ver si, como el del Betis, también les llega pronto al 11 y al 4
articles.body: La Real Sociedad ha realizado este lunes por la tarde el primero de los dos únicos entrenamientos que tendrá antes de la visita del miércoles al Real Madrid en el Santiago Bernabéu, con la ausencia de Ander Barrenetxea, que fue sustituido el viernes pasado, como hecho más destacado. Jon Mikel Aramburu, que terminó cojeando esa cita ante el Betis, sí se ha ejercitado, lo mismo que Jon Gorrotxategi y Gonçalo Guedes, que acumulan un ensayo más de cara a estar, al menos, disponibles para entrar en una convocatoria. Veremos si la de mañana les llega aún pronto o no. El ensayo ha comenzado con las felicitaciones a Aihen Muñoz, por su partido 200 el viernes pasado contra el Betis, a Álex Marchal, por su debut con la Real en Primera en ese encuentro en La Cartuja, Alex Lebarbier, por su reciente cumpleaños, con un pasillo de collejas a los tres que se ha perdido Barrenetxea. El 7 pidió el cambio el viernes pasado poco antes de la hora de juego en La Cartuja por unas molestias debido a un golpe en el gemelo, que ha hecho que no saltase al verde por precaución y que le convierte en duda para ir al Bernabéu, teniendo en cuenta que el sábado la Real tendrá un tercer partido en sólo ocho días, contra el Espanyol en Anoeta. Los que sí han estado sobre el césped de Zubieta han sido Jon Mikel Aramburu, que terminó cojeando en Sevilla pero parece recuperado, y Jon Gorrotxategi y Gonçalo Guedes, que no viajaron al estar en la fase final de recuperación de los respectivos problemas físicos que han tenido este verano. Habrá que ver si están ya aptos para, al menos, sentarse en el banquillo del Bernabéu, o Matarazzo debe continuar esperando para tenerles a sus órdenes. Los que van a ser por segunda jornada seguida bajas seguras son Álvaro Odriozola, lesionado de larga duración, y Pablo Marín.

articles.title: El fin de una era: adiós a los recogepelotas
articles.standfirst: Las nuevas medidas de LaLiga indican que el balón debe colocarse en un soporte para evitar pérdidas de tiempo
articles.summary: Las nuevas medidas de LaLiga indican que el balón debe colocarse en un soporte para evitar pérdidas de tiempo
articles.body: En los tiempos modernos en los que vivimos, el fútbol sigue modificando sus normas para agilizar el ritmo y para facilitar el juego rápido. Una de estas nuevas medidas indican que los recogepelotas no pueden interferir como hacían antes, ahora deben colocar los balones en los soportes facilitados colocados a lo largo del terreno de juego, pero en ningún caso proporcionarlo directamente al jugador o lanzarlo al campo. Esta norma se ha creado con la intención de agilizar y normalizar el ritmo que debe tener un encuentro. Sobre todo, teniendo en cuenta el rol del recogepelotas como local. En este caso, esta figura podía realentizar el partido si el equipo va ganando y acelerarlo en caso de resultado negativo para el conjunto que juegue en casa. En esta nueva medida, el propio recogepelotas tendrá que intervenir solo para la colocación cuando la pelota salga y deberá volver detrás de las vallas publicitarias. A su vez, los balones estarán custodiados tanto en el descanso como en el desenlace del encuentro. En la historia de LaLiga, aparecen figuras relevantes que, siendo niños, comenzaron a ser recogepelotas y han llegado a ser estrellas de nuestro campeonato con el paso de los años. Jugadores de la talla de Brahim Díaz, que era un habitual en La Rosaleda celebrando los goles de Isco o Cazorla. En el Atlético de Madrid, una de las historias más bonitas es la de saga Simeone. En el antiguo Calderón, se puede ver alguna imagen de un niño con un peto por las bandas del campo celebrando los tantos de los colchoneros abrazado con el Cholo. Hablamos de Giuliano Simeone, titular en el Atlético de Madrid y jugador de la selección argentina. En el mismo Atlético de Madrid hay otro caso de un chaval que está comenzando a despuntar. Se trata de Iker Luque, el joven jugador que marcó el gol de la victoria en Mestalla el pasado 2 de mayo. Hace no tantos años, era habitual que le lanzara balones en el Calderón a Koke, Griezmann, Oblak o Fernando Torres. Allá por los años 80, en el Camp Nou, un Pep Guardiola de niño era el encargado de los balones en el estadio. No mucho después fue el líder del centro del campo blaugrana del Barcelona de Johan Cruyff y un tiempo después, el técnico de uno de los equipos más temibles de la historia de este deporte. Una figura que ya no será la misma en este fútbol actual. Una presencia que se limita a colocar balones y posicionarse detrás de las vallas publicitarias para modificar el ritmo del juego. Una 'picardía' de niños que muchos echarán de menos, pero que se necesita entender para el bien de este deporte y su desarrollo.

articles.title: Julian Alvarez transfer news: Arsenal, Barcelona or Atletico Madrid stay for striker?
articles.summary: An analysis of Julian Alvarez's future with the transfer window closing on 1 September - and the Argentine's chances of a move from Atletico Madrid to Arsenal.
articles.body:
Acrimony, anger and animosity: the Julian Alvarez summer transfer saga in a nutshell.

The boos aimed at the Atletico Madrid forward from his own supporters at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium on Sunday provided the latest twist in what has been one of the most bitter - and certainly public - storylines of the window.

And with deadline day on 1 September, the Argentine World Cup winner's future remains one of the hottest topics.

In simplistic terms the dispute comes down to this: Alvarez wants to join Barcelona - but Atletico won't let him.

The Madrid club's steadfast refusal to sanction the 26-year-old's dream move to the Spotify Camp Nou has led to one of the most rancorous public falling-outs in recent memory.

The feud led to Atleti fans jeering their own player on his return to club action after the summer World Cup in a 2-2 home draw with Villarreal on Sunday.

Atletico Madrid president Enrique Cerezo, speaking last week, said: "I don't know if he will say sorry, but Julian is an excellent person and I am absolutely sure that he will win over the fans in two games.

"I said he wouldn't be sold, he's our player and an important part of our team. We like that he's with us and think he will have a magnificent season."

Nevertheless, the events that unfolded on Sunday certainly haven't gone unnoticed at Arsenal .

BBC Sport has consistently reported over the summer that Alvarez is viewed as the Gunners' dream transfer target.

But for the vast majority of the window, Arsenal 's interest has been largely dormant because they were fully aware of his desire to join Barcelona.

They have been waiting for the right moment to strike and those at the Emirates are hopeful that time may be coming.

Gunners lying in wait and ready to move quickly

Arsenal are realistic about their chances of signing Alvarez before next week's transfer deadline.

Do they want him? Yes. Are they trying? Yes. Can they pull it off? The answer to that question is less unequivocal.

Manager Mikel Arteta and sporting director Andrea Berta know it is a long shot, not least because former Manchester City forward Alvarez, at least so far, has shown little indication he would be willing to join the club.

His current reluctance to give the green light on a move to London isn't necessarily linked to any apprehension towards Arsenal - but rather that doing so would see him forgoing his dream of joining Barcelona.

Alvarez has also been made aware of certain visa regulations that would create difficulty for his family visiting him in the UK.

Moving to Catalonia is what he truly wants.

What's more, the Camp Nou club are absolutely willing to make that happen.

But Atleti are absolutely adamant they will not sell Alvarez to Barcelona.

In May, they made a series of social media posts brutally mocking the pursuit by the Spanish champions of their player to millions of followers.

"Don't believe everything you see, especially if it's related to Barca," Atletico posted. "In recent months, we've been suffering a smear campaign against one of our players."

For the Madrid side, the matter is closed and that leaves Alvarez's dream in serious jeopardy.

Therein lies a sliver of hope for Arsenal because, as things stand, the only way out is a move to the Emirates Stadium.

Indeed, according to well-placed sources there has been a slight softening of Alvarez's stance in recent days, although not enough yet to get anyone at Arsenal excited.

But should he change his mind in the final days of the window, then the Gunners are poised.

Since the start of the summer, according to BBC Sport sources, Arsenal have been confident Alvarez's move to Barcelona was a non-starter.

But while he still harboured hope of fulfilling that ambition, Arteta's men focused on the captures of Bruno Guimaraes and Ezri Konsa, while also trying to bring Real Madrid attacker Vinicius Jr to London.

With the Brazilian extending his contract to stay in Spain, Arsenal have now decided to step things up regarding Alvarez.

Atleti director Mateu Alemany was in London last week, where he is understood to have met with Arsenal counterparts - and made clear his side would seek a fee of 150m euros (£128m).

The Gunners are confident they can finance any deal and quickly finalise the transfer - if he said yes.

Arteta is fully aware if Alvarez was to join Arsenal this summer he would only be doing so because his preferred destination was not possible.

It is understood the Spaniard is comfortable with that scenario and believes Alvarez would eventually become fully invested and committed to the Arsenal project.

The ball is now in Alvarez's court. If he wants to leave Atletico, which sources close to the attacker insist that he does, then the Premier League champions appear to be his only option.

Alvarez joined Atletico for £81m from Manchester City in August 2024 , having spent just over two years at the Etihad following a £14.1m move from Argentine side River Plate.

He won six major trophies at City - including the Treble of Premier League, FA Cup and Champions League in 2023 - scoring 36 goals in 106 appearances.

At Atletico, he has scored 49 goals in 107 appearances, but has not yet won any silverware.

Could Alvarez also concede defeat in his efforts to leave Atleti this summer and attempt to mend what appears to be a broken relationship with the club and its supporters?

It is possible, although, according to those close to the player, it is his belief that the Madrid club are being unreasonable. Indeed the player's agent Fernando Hidalgo has been open with his disdain towards how his client has been treated this summer.

That said, Alvarez is described as a private individual and said to be deeply uncomfortable about the very public nature of the conflict with his club - although the player himself also outlined his desire to leave publicly during the World Cup.

"A transfer is the best option," he said.

When Real Madrid released a statement on 9 June saying they had an offer of 150m euros (£128m) rejected by their neighbours, there was a sense from the Alvarez camp Atletico had reneged on an agreement to let the striker leave if they received an offer of that amount.

Of course, the prospect of selling Alvarez to their fiercest rivals was viewed as a non-starter by Atletico.

For South Americans - playing for Real or Barca represents the holy grail.

Hansi Flick's side remain interested in Alvarez, but fear Atletico's stance isn't purely posturing and have started to consider alternative options, including Arsenal 's Swedish striker Viktor Gyokeres.

If they decide to turn their attention elsewhere, Alvarez will have a decision to make.

Arsenal or nothing? We'll have the answer soon.

articles.title: Dos partidos, un sorteo y la hoja de ruta de Pellegrini en el mercado
articles.standfirst: El Betis afronta la última semana completa de agosto con numerosos frentes abiertos
articles.summary: El Betis afronta la última semana completa de agosto con numerosos frentes abiertos
articles.body: La última semana completa del mes de agosto aparece cargada de fechas importantes para el Betis. Las prioritarias, lógicamente las de sus dos siguientes compromisos ligueros, ambos a domicilio y en la misma ciudad, Valencia, frente al conjunto che mañana por la noche en Mestalla y ante el Levante en el estadio Ciudad de Valencia el sábado. Pero la actividad verdiblanca estos días no se limita sólo a lo que se verá sobre el césped... Con el mercado abierto y menos de 10 días de la fecha límite para terminar de configurar las plantillas, la Dirección Deportiva que lidera Manu Fajardo sabe que tiene trabajo por delante. El Betis tiene a varias operaciones pendientes, tanto de entrada como de salida, con las que intentará elevar el nivel del equipo de cara a una temporada muy exigente, con el objetivo de repetir de nuevo clasificación europea en LaLiga y llegar lejos en la Copa, pero con presencia entre los grandes del Viejo Continente disputando la Champions. Jugadores como Gonzalo Petit, Iker Losada o Pablo García aparecen la rampa de salida. También sigue abierto a lo que pueda ocurrir con Nelson Deossa tras rechazar el colombiano marcharse a Brasil para jugar en el Vasco de Gama. Y no se descarta alguna otra venta importante que pueda generar plusvalías o un significativo ahorro salarial con el que poder afrontar con mayor margen y garantías la llegada de uno o dos futbolistas al equipo. Y ahí es donde Manuel Pellegrini ha marcado su particular hoja de ruta de manera pública... Cuestionado en la sala de prensa, el Ingeniero ha hablado de "prioridad" a la hora de señalar el fichaje de un mediocentro de corte defensivo. Es más, no se ha podido la lengua al decir que "contar con un jugador que ya estuvo aquí" sería un "avance importante" en relación a la figura de Sofyan Amrabat, su apuesta personal. Un movimiento que condiciona o que pondría un escalón por debajo el deseo del club de recuperar a Dani Ceballos, libre desde hace más de un mes y que sigue esperando que el Betis consiga encajar su salario en el ajustado límite del que dispone a estas alturas de verano. El caso de Amrabat es complicado por dos motivos: primero, porque sigue teniendo contrato hasta 2028 con el Fenerbahçe, más allá de que el conjunto turco cuente o no con él; segundo, porque su salario es muy elevado para el margen de los verdiblancos. Así que la llegada del internacional marroquí, salvo alguna venta importante que permita disponer de mayor límite, sólo podría darse con una nueva cesión en la que su club actual se haga cargo de una parte importante de su ficha. Los próximos días son definitivos tras un encuentro con su agente hace pocas semanas en el que se le trasladó que en ese momento no había forma de encajar su fichaje y tendría que esperar. Ceballos aparece, por su parte, como una incorporación planteada más por parte del club y la Dirección Deportiva que del propio cuerpo técnico. Un jugador que, tras su marcha al Real Madrid hace años, ha sonado de manera recurrente, pero que después de rescindir su contrato sí aparece ahora como una posibilidad real. Encajar a ambos en el límite de gasto en plantilla fijado por LaLiga parece a día de hoy complicado para un Betis que sigue necesitando plusvalías para compensar las pérdidas sufridas la pasada temporada. Y por si dos partidos y los últimos días de mercado fueran poco, los verdiblancos afrontan también la semana en la que conocerán quiénes serán sus rivales en la fase de liga de la Champions League. El próximo jueves por la tarde se llevará a cabo el sorteo en el que el equipo de Pellegrini conocerá ante qué ocho adversarios, cuatro en casa, en La Cartuja, y otros cuatro a domicilio, regresará a la máxima competición continental y se jugará estar en las rondas eliminatoria de febrero y marzo. Siete días intensos con varios frentes abiertos en Heliópolis.

articles.title: Luis Enrique recuerda la vuelta de Figo al Camp Nou: "Ganamos el partido porque era imposible no ganarlo"
articles.standfirst: Imágenes exclusivas del reportaje 'El Camp Nou: bienvenidos al estadio' disponible en Movistar Plus
articles.summary: Imágenes exclusivas del reportaje 'El Camp Nou: bienvenidos al estadio' disponible en Movistar Plus
articles.body: Los clásicos siempre tienen una gran rivalidad y tensión. La era Mourinho-Guardiola fue el máximo esplendor de la rivalidad. Sin embargo, hubo un día en el que un campo de fútbol se convirtió en un 'infierno' constante para un futbolista. Fue el 21 de octubre del 2000, cuando Figo regresó al campo del Barcelona. Luis Enrique ha recordado aquella noche en el reportaje 'El Camp Nou: bienvenidos al estadio' disponible en Movistar Plus. El técnico español comenta que esa noche fue la que más caldeado vio el campo en su carera como jugador: "El partido que más ambiente viví como jugador en el Camp Nou, y jugué 8 años, fue el día que volvió Figo". El portugués era el mejor futbolista del mundo. Tan solo dos meses después de su regreso, recibió el Balón de Oro. Un futbolista clave para los culés, que reforzó a su máximo rival. "Figo era un hermano para nosotros, un hermano de verdad. Era nuestro mejor jugador, que se marchó a Madrid", dice. El ahora entrenador del PSG explica que ese día, la situación que se vivía, era completamente diferente a la habitual. "El Camp Nou es un estadio que llegas media horita antes y está medio vacío. Cuando sales a calentar, hay poca gente. Aquel día, 45 minutos antes, estaba lleno a reventar. Calentando, no nos oíamos. Me acuerdo de comentar con el Pitu, creo que estaba Pep también, que 'es imposible que perdamos. Es imposible. Da igual quién juegue con la camiseta de Barça, es imposible que perdamos'. Había una energía que daba hasta miedo", afirma. Y así pasó. El Barcelona se llevó los tres puntos tras ganar 2-0, uno de los goles del propio Luis Enrique. Aunque esa victoria fue más que un simple clásico para los culés. "Me acuerdo que al Figo le marcó Puyi (Puyol), un Puyi muy joven, pero una bestia de Puyi. Figo fue el mejor del Madrid, a pesar de aquella presión que yo no había ni siquiera imaginado. Y ganamos el partido porque era imposible no ganarlo", cuenta.  A pesar de ser grandes rivales, Luis Enrique dice que es necesaria esa relación: "Es una rivalidad que yo creo que es hasta necesaria. ¿Qué sería el Madrid sin el Barça y el Barça sin el Madrid? Que se vayan a otra liga. Barça y Madrid son dos equipos que se necesitan". A pesar de los grandes momentos que vivió como jugador y como entrenador, el técnico del PSG cierra la puerta tras ser preguntado por la posibilidad de volver a sentarse en el banquillo azulgrana. "¿La verdad? No", añade.

articles.title: Sivera renueva hasta 2030
articles.standfirst: El guardameta finalizaba su contrato al término de este curso y extiende tres años más su compromiso como babazorro
articles.summary: El guardameta finalizaba su contrato al término de este curso y extiende tres años más su compromiso como babazorro
articles.body: Golpe sobre la mesa del Alavés. Antonio Sivera seguirá al frente de la portería babazorra hasta 2030. El guardameta de Jávea terminaba contrato al término de la presente campaña, pero ha llegado a un acuerdo con el club para ampliar tres campañas más su compromiso. Una gran noticia para la escuadra vitoriana, que llevaba tiempo en conversaciones con el capitán para poder extender su contrato y este lunes lo ha oficializado. Sivera cumple este año su décima campaña como integrante del Alavés. Aterrizó en Vitoria en 2017 procedente del Valencia y se ha consolidado en la portería de Mendizorroza hasta el punto de ser indiscutible en las última cuatro temporadas después de vivir a la sombra de Pacheco en sus inicios. En total ha disputado 179 encuentros y con este nuevo compromiso tiene tiempo y partidos por delante para situarse en un escalón privilegiado en la historia del Alavés. A sus 30 años, Sivera era un portero que podía ser susceptible de recibir propuestas de otros conjuntos de Primera después del nivel ofrecido en las últimas temporadas, pero ha priorizado la confianza que siempre le ha transmitido el Alavés y sentirse una pieza fundamental dentro del proyecto. Así, el portero alicantino alcanzará las 13 temporadas como jugador babazorro si consigue cumplir el contrato, algo que no ha hecho nadie en la historia del club. En los despachos de Mendizorroza eran consientes de que había dos jugadores capitales dentro del equipo que finalizaban contrato en 2027: Antonio Blanco y Sivera. El club no se ha planteado en ningún momento sus salidas, pese a la amenaza de que pudieran irse gratis el próximo verano. Con Sivera ‘atado’, la Dirección Deportiva quemará ahora todos los cartuchos para poder retener a Blanco, aunque eso parece una misión mucho más complicada.

articles.title: Uriarte: "Nos espera una temporada complicada y larga"
articles.standfirst: El presidente sorprende con su discurso en el tradicional acto en la Basílica de Begoña
articles.summary: El presidente sorprende con su discurso en el tradicional acto en la Basílica de Begoña
articles.body: La derrota en el Sevilla fue un amargo inicio para la Aste Nagusia bilbaína, que esa misma tarde lanzó el chupinazo. Este lunes, todavía en el primer tramo festivo, el discurso que ha realizado el presidente Uriarte en el tradicional acto con el que cada campaña se da inicio a la temporada en la Basílica de Begoña no dejará indiferentes. "Nos espera una temporada larga y dura", resaltó. Uriarte y su directiva han asistido a la Basílica de Begoña al frente de los primeros equipos masculino y femenino y una representación del Genuine a un acto religioso en el que además de una ofrenda por parte de los capitanes hay un reconocimiento a los socios fallecidos. Edin Terzic y Víctor Martín, técnicos de los equipos cabecera de ambas secciones, es la primera vez que lo han vivido. El acto de este lunes se enmarca dentro de las celebraciones del club por la Aste Nagusia. Esta misma mañana, antes de acudir a la Basílica de Begoña, la dirección del Athletic ha recibido en dos recepciones distintas a representantes del Ayuntamiento de Bilbao y el Gobierno Vasco. Las palabras de Uriarte llegan después de una primera derrota y a horas de visitar el Camp Nou. El Athletic cerrará la semana visitando al Celta. El curso pasado el equipo arrancó la Liga con tres victorias consecutivas en el mes de agosto. "Será una temporada complicada y larga, pero como siempre, como bien sabe la Amatxu de Begoña, saldremos adelante. Siempre adelante", expresó.. El párroco Angel Unanue ha recibido a la comitiva rojiblanca en la entrada al templo y después de recibir la ofrenda rojiblanca ha lanzado un mensaje a los futbolistas. "Vosotros, desde vuestro trabajo, sois considerados por los jóvenes como punto de referencia. Y desde esa situación tenéis que estar preparados para vivir bajo la lupa del juicio público. Tenéis que ser espejo y referente", destacó.

articles.title: Aston Villa: Ollie Watkins transfer saga leaves Villa shellshocked
articles.summary: Ollie Watkins has been an Aston Villa legend but it appears his time at the club is nearing a painful end amid interest from Saudi Arabia.
articles.body:
Last year, it was Emi Martinez looking to leave for Manchester United . When asked about the Argentina goalkeeper's absence from last season's opening league match against Crystal Palace , head coach Unai Emery just repeated replacement Marco Bizot's name several times.

Twelve months on, for their Premier League opener at Brighton on Sunday, Ollie Watkins was the name to make Emery bristle.

"This question is for him. I can answer only with my silence," he said, when asked why the striker was not included.

That Villa lost 4-0 - conceding all four in a calamitous opening 31 minutes before having debutant Joao Gomes sent off - merely added to the perceived insult.

Saudi Pro League side Al-Hilal have had four offers rejected for Watkins - whose time at Villa now appears to be at a tumultuous end.

Al-Hilal, who have offered close to £40m, are not near to Aston Villa 's asking price. As next Tuesday's transfer deadline nears, Villa will play hardball for their all-time record Premier League goalscorer.

A deal is still believed to be some way off, even if Emery revealed last week the striker could leave.

Al-Hilal, who signed Crysensio Summerville from West Ham in July , are likely to need to move one of their overseas players to make room for Watkins, despite loaning Darwin Nunez to Diriyah last week, so there are other moving parts in the deal.

Watkins has been training on his own, having returned from an extended break following the World Cup and is understood to have made his feelings clear to the Villa hierarchy about moving.

There have been no public comments from Watkins or his representatives but he is understood to be open to the move.

They have also kept quiet about Emery's response - particularly his enigmatic "silence" answer to Sky Sports' question on why his striker was not involved at Brighton , which appeared to lay the blame at Watkins' door.

Another unanswered question is whether Villa see the Saudi money for a striker turning 31 in December - and who had been in and out of Emery's team last season - as a good deal.

Perhaps the very real pain at this potential break-up is the reason for the difficulties.

The 30-year-old has 108 goals in 278 games for Villa after joining from Brentford for a then-record £28m and has been synonymous with Villa's rise of the past six years.

The triumphant night in Istanbul, when Watkins helped Villa end their 30-year wait for a trophy as they beat Freiburg to win the Europa League, currently stand as a crowning glory.

His departure would be the most emotional of this summer's big exits - as while Ezri Konsa's influence was crucial, Watkins' goals, work-rate and nature made him one of Villa's poster boys.

He is a grounded and family-orientated individual who enjoys the occasional game of golf but always focuses on his football.

But he has been in this position before, although at a lower level.

Having initially been left out by Paul Tisdale at Exeter amid interest from Derby in 2017, he pleaded with the manager to play and came off the bench to score in a win against Wycombe.

Given he has that attitude and desire, those at Villa are surprised at how the relationship with Watkins is ending. It was not expected to be like this.

Had it been someone different, a player who had previously not been a manager's dream to work with, Emery's response might have been more indifferent.

Villa's transfer trouble before deadline

Along with Watkins, Villa must resolve Martinez's future after a second summer of discontent from the Argentina international.

A move to Juventus fell through earlier this month, as they were unwilling to meet Villa's financial demands, and a solution must be found for the 33-year-old after the signing of Zion Suzuki to become the club's number one.

Signing a striker to replace Watkins will be harder than sourcing Konsa's replacement - on which Villa are already working, having had two bids rejected by Southampton for Taylor Harwood-Bellis.

Brian Madjo's availability, after VIlla won their battle against Fifa to register him , gives Emery an additional option, although at 17 the striker cannot be expected to carry the burden.

Villa have been open to letting Tammy Abraham leave but Watkins' increasingly likely departure will have an impact on that thinking.

Striker Abraham, who joined from Besiktas in January, has not been looking for any Villa Park exit and remains happy at the club.

Nicolas Jackson remains a top target for Emery, who worked with the Chelsea forward at Villarreal, while there has been no direct contact with Manchester United over Joshua Zirkzee.

Emery needs to find new heroes after the exits of Morgan Rogers and Youri Tielemans - two Istanbul goalscorers - along with Lucas Digne and Konsa.

But if Watkins goes, his departure will cut the deepest.

articles.title: Jules Ahoka: Sunderland sign midfielder from Royal Antwerp
articles.summary: Sunderland confirm the signing of midfielder Jules Ahoka for a 10m euros (£8.6m) fee.
articles.body:
Sunderland have signed midfielder Jules Ahoka from Belgian side Royal Antwerp for 10m euros (£8.6m).

The Black Cats said the 20-year-old DR Congo youth international has signed a long-term contract with the club.

"I am very happy and proud to join Sunderland ," said Ahoka, who featured in both of Antwerp's league games this season.

"It is a big club with great ambitions, and I am excited to be here.

"I want to work hard, learn from my team-mates and the staff, and continue developing as a player. I will give everything for the club and I cannot wait to get started."

Ahoka becomes the Black Cats' third summer signing, following the arrival of Belgian left-back Thomas Meunier and French right-back Dayann Methalie.

"Jules is a player we have been following closely and he has shown some very encouraging qualities for his age," said Sunderland director of football Florent Ghisolfi.

"He has huge potential and we believe Sunderland is the right environment for him to continue his development."

Sunderland were beaten 2-1 by Ipswich in their Premier League opener on Saturday. Their next match is against Fulham on Sunday (14:00 BST).

articles.summary: La Delegación de Gobierno en la Comunitat Valenciana, mientras, niega que se requisaran esteladas en el Elche-Barça
articles.body: Fernando Grande-Marlaska, ministro del Interior, ha ordenado, según el diario El Mundo, investigar a los Policías que cargaron contra aficionados del Barcelona en el partido de este domingo contra el Elche. Además, la Delegación del Gobierno en la Comunitat Valenciana ha informado también este lunes de que ha abierto una investigación interna en la Policía Nacional sobre la actuación de los agentes y desmintió que se requisase ninguna bandera estelada por parte de los policías que intervinieron.  Junts, ERC y la CUP denunciaron este lunes la actuación de agentes de la Policía Nacional contra seguidores del Barcelona en la previa del encuentro, en la que un hincha fue golpeado por varios policías, según imágenes difundidas en las redes sociales. El vídeo muestra cómo agentes de la Policía Nacional golpearon a un joven tras arrebatarle una estelada, que permanece en manos de uno de los policías durante toda la escena. El joven se encaró con los policías y estos terminaron golpeándole con las porras en el suelo. El Barcelona también condenó el uso "desproporcionado" de la fuerza por parte de la Policía, lamentó que, "una vez más", agentes policiales "requisaran banderas esteladas a aficionados azulgranas" y se puso a disposición del seguidor detenido y de su familia "para ofrecerles el apoyo que puedan necesitar".

articles.title: Alistair Johnston: Celtic full-back out with injury until October
articles.summary: Celtic full-back Alistair Johnston will be out of action until October, manager Martin O'Neill confirms.
articles.body:
Celtic full-back Alistair Johnston will be out of action until October, manager Martin O'Neill has confirmed.

The Canada international, 27, went off at half-time in the second game of the season against Kilmarnock, having missed most of the last campaign with a hamstring injury.

Now a scan has revealed he faces another spell on the sidelines.

"There was definitely something there, and I think the prognosis is really that it will be some time in October for him," said O'Neill prior to the Champions League play-off second leg away to LASK.

Celtic have bolstered their attacking options over the summer and been linked with a number of midfielders and O'Neill concedes the defensive area is one that needs strengthening.

"If you consider that Kieran [Tierney] is essentially our only left-sided full-back, we'll have a little look," he added.

"But I really will not concentrate on anything at all until after the game, regardless of what the result is or whichever competition we happen to be in.

"We've got some days before the transfer deadline [3 September], and I hope that we will get some people in."

O'Neill said there was nothing further to report on links with Ermin Mahmic of Slovan Liberec or Torino's Gvidas Gineitis.

"I was told some weeks ago that we'd lost 14 players and we'd only replaced them with two at the time," O'Neill continued.

"But I think the whole thing was balanced out. There were some of those players that we took on loan, that were going to be leaving anyway, weren't going to be coming back. And it was a matter of trying to get a little bit of quality in.

"I think that we could fill up the squad if you wanted to, with loads of names. But it was a bit of quality that we were looking for because that eventually would be, I think, of paramount importance between now and January."

Colby Donovan, 19, has been deputising for Johnston, impressing in the 3-0 first leg win over LASK at Celtic Park, while Scotland international Anthony Ralston is another option for O'Neill at right-back.

articles.title: 49ers owner Jed York pleads no contest to two misdemeanor charges in Ohio
articles.summary: Court records show that York initially was charged with engaging in prostitution, but prosecutors amended that to disorderly conduct.
articles.body: San Francisco 49ers owner Jed York was arrested over the weekend in Ohio and pleaded no contest to misdemeanor charges of disorderly conduct and possessing criminal tools. York was arrested Sunday in East Palestine, Ohio, and was released after posting a $5,000 bond. He was sentenced to one day in jail for both offenses to be served concurrently and was credited with one day served when he pleaded no contest Monday morning. He also was fined $1,150. Court records show that York initially was charged with engaging in prostitution, but prosecutors amended that to disorderly conduct. Records also show that York had a cellphone returned to him and that $160 that was seized was to be given to the Mahoning Valley Human Trafficking Task Force as part of the plea agreement. York also completed an online course. The 49ers and the NFL didn’t immediately respond to requests for comment. The 46-year-old York took over day-to-day control of the 49ers from his parents in 2008. He became the team’s principal owner in 2024. After some initial struggles under York’s leadership, the team has been a consistent contender since hiring coach Kyle Shanahan and general manager John Lynch in 2017. The Niners have made the Super Bowl three times under York’s leadership, losing in the 2012 season under coach Jim Harbaugh and the 2019 and ’23 seasons under Shanahan and Lynch. York also oversaw the building of Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, California. The team moved from San Francisco to the new stadium in 2014. The stadium has hosted two Super Bowls, a World Cup and a College Football Playoff title game.

articles.title: Xavi Espart, el Philipp Lahm de Flick
articles.standfirst: El técnico, que apuesta por el canterano, le ve similitudes con el alemán
articles.summary: El técnico, que apuesta por el canterano, le ve similitudes con el alemán
articles.body: Xavi Espart sigue sumando elogios, y ganándose la confianza de Hansi Flick. El joven culé, de 19 años, fue una de las sorpresas en el once del Barcelona en el estreno de la temporada 26-27 en el cruce contra el Elche. El polivalente futbolista tiene encandilado al técnico alemán, que hace unos meses comparó al catalán con su compatriota Philipp Lahm. En el Martínez Valero dio otro recital de juego,  y eso que se movió en el lateral zurdo... "Me recuerda a Philipp Lahm", comentó Hansi Flick cuando se refirió a Xavi Espart en la rueda de prensa previa al partido de Champions League contra el Newcastle del pasado mes de marzo. Su comparativa generó cierto asombro entre los presentes. Su confrontación eran palabras mayores. Pero el preparador germano vio muy pronto, al verlo en algunas sesiones, similitudes entre el joven de La Masia, al que hizo debutar la temporada pasada. y uno de los jugadores internacionales alemanes más reconocidos en las dos primeras décadas del siglo XXI. "Cuando lo veo jugar me gusta mucho su confianza con la pelota. Me recuerda a Lahm, que puede jugar de 6 y de 2. Me gusta verlo con el balón y sin él", dijo en otra ocasión Flick, insistiendo en las semejanzas. De hecho, el preparador azulgrana no sólo está sacando un gran rendimiento de la calidad del internacional sub 19 y de las características que comparte con el exfutbolista germano (inteligencia táctica, anticipación, buena salida del balón, habilidad en la recuperación...) sino que está explotando muy bien su versatilidad. Como el exjugador del Bayern de Múnich, Espart suma intervenciones en varias demarcaciones.  Lahm jugó la mayor parte de sus encuentros de lateral derecho, izquierdo y pivote, aunque se movió por casi todo el campo. El joven culé intervino contra el Elche, participó en los 90 minutos, en el ala zurda de la defensa (Balde fue baja por decisión técnica y Cancelo está falto de ritmo), pero este verano Flick le había colocado, durante los cruces de la pretemporada, en la derecha y en la medular. En todas las ubicaciones destacó.  Contra el Elche, tuvo una actuación más que sobresaliente. Sus registros confirmaron su calidad y su personalidad: intervino, con su presión, en la acción que concluyó en el penalti sobre Raphinha; le dio la asistencia a Fermín López en su segundo gol; creó una gran ocasión; completó el 85 por ciento de sus conexiones; ganó 7 de 11 duelos en el suelo y los tres aéreos que probó, y firmó un regate, dos entradas, dos intercepciones, cinco despejes y seis recuperaciones. "Es impresionante, sabe lo que tiene que hacer y es fantástico con la pelota", sentenció Flick tras el encuentro. Flick no sólo ve en él su calidad, con y sin balón, también resalta su personalidad. Espart, que suma siete partidos en la elite, tiene un atrevimiento y una ambición que el preparador aplaude. "He jugado siempre de pivote, pero aquí en el primer equipo llevo tres años haciendo de lateral. Por estar en el Barça, jugaría en la posición que fuese. Por haber sido pivote, puedo ser un lateral distinto, que puedo asociarme por dentro en lugar de ser un carrilero. Me estoy adaptando bien y estoy en forma tras el Europeo, así que a tope. Desde la humildad y el trabajo, quiero demostrar que puedo estar aquí", comentó hace poco más de un mes.

articles.title: Lane Kiffin Explains Recruiting NFL's Dae'Quan Wright, Zxavian Harris to LSU
articles.summary: Tight end Dae'Quan Wright is currently at the center of a storm that is NCAA eligibility after he signed with the Cleveland Browns as an undrafted free agent this offseason but is now joining LSU on the transfer portal after being waived.
articles.body:
Tight end Dae'Quan Wright is currently at the center of a storm that is NCAA eligibility after he signed with the Cleveland Browns as an undrafted free agent this offseason but is now joining LSU on the transfer portal after being waived.

Kiffin and Co. also landed a commitment from former New Orleans Saints defensive end Zxavian Harrison, according to On3's Pete Nakos:

"Through (players) winning injunctions and entry into the portal, they are available to recruit," LSU head coach Lane Kiffin told reporters on Monday. "Ourselves and many places around the country are recruiting them. ... Because of the rulings, they are going to play for you or someone else. We made the decision to recruit them. It's wrong to be critical of these kids. They were granted a fifth year and a judge said they were wronged. ... These players should have been told that they were going to be eligible for a fifth year. Had they known that, they would have stayed (and not signed pro contracts). You may end up having hundreds of athletes told they have a fifth year. It's a unique circumstance."

Cleveland Browns head coach Todd Monken had his own take on the situation after Wright dressed for the team's second preseason game, though he didn't appear in the contest.

"Man, that s--t is crazy. I don't even know what to say," he told reporters . "As far as I know he had a medical issue that wasn't allowing him to practice, it's nothing to do with me. And then he was cleared so we dressed him just in case we had to have him. But when you don't rep it's hard to put him on the field. ... I wondered why Lane Kiffin reached out a week ago. Now I know. S--t, I didn't know, now I know. I didn't call him back, guess I should've"

Wright went undrafted and was initially signed by the Philadelphia Eagles before being waived and claimed on waivers by the Browns on Aug. 11.

The NCAA's rule to allow the majority of Division I athletes five years of eligibility over the course of five years going forward didn't grandfather in players like Wright and other athletes who started their college careers in the 2022-23 academic year. He was among a group of athletes in Louisiana who filed a lawsuit disputing that decision and was granted a temporary restraining order that will allow him to play at the college level in 2026.

More lawsuits and court cases are likely coming, but for the time being, Wright will be joining LSU for the 2026 season.

articles.title: Ryan Day Gives Ohio State's Stance on NFL Players Returning to CFB amid Dae'Quan Wright-LSU Buzz
articles.summary: With college sports potentially evolving in another new, disruptive way, Ohio State coach Ryan Day will continue to adapt whether he likes it or not.
articles.body:
With college sports potentially evolving in another new, disruptive way, Ohio State coach Ryan Day will continue to adapt whether he likes it or not.

ESPN's Adam Schefter reported that tight end Dae'Quan Wright has an agreement in place to suit up for LSU in 2026 despite signing with an NFL team this offseason. Thanks to a temporary restraining order from a Louisiana judge, Wright is among a group of athletes who could gain an additional year of college eligibility.

Day said Monday the situation "is frustrating at the very least" in that the regular season is less than two weeks away and teams may still be adding to their rosters. At the same time, the coach isn't going to turn down the chance to bring in a player who can make a positive impact.

"But we also, if there are teams that have some players out there who are cut from NFL rosters that are gonna be on other teams, we have to at least consider it and look at it," Day said, per per Spencer Holbrook of Letterman Row. "Do I like anything about it? Absolutely not, but we gotta do what's right for Ohio State. So it's sort of a day-to-day thing right now. And like anything, we're just gonna try to adapt. But I think we would all agree, maybe not everybody, but that there has to be a certain point where your roster gets locked in."

In a business as cutthroat as high-level college sports, you often don't get very far by sticking to your principles. Just ask Clemson coach Dabo Swinney.

The Tigers have fallen off in recent years, and part of that is down to Swinney's broad aversion to the transfer portal. He hamstrings himself by not targeting immediate reinforcements as aggressively as his peers.

For Day in particular, the expectations from Buckeyes fans are so unforgiving. It's not enough to beat Michigan and claim a Big Ten title anymore.

To continue qualifying for the College Football Playoff and advance in the bracket, Day and his staff need to keep the pipeline of high-level talent flowing. In time, that could mean waiting for NFL teams to make their final cuts to see whether some notable standouts will fall back into the college ranks.

Like Day, OSU fans may have their own qualms with college sports becoming professionalized in concrete ways, but they're still counting on the program to find whatever edges it can to win.

articles.title: What to Know About Justin Buzzard, 47-Year-Old Pastor Who Joined CFB Team as DE
articles.summary: They say it's never too late to follow your dreams, and a 47-year-old California pastor is proving just that.
articles.body:
They say it's never too late to follow your dreams, and a 47-year-old California pastor is proving just that.

Justin Buzzard is set to join the San Jose City College Jaguars as a defensive end, nearly 30 years after he last played in a college football game.

"No one's going easy on me... and I'm not going easy on them," Justin Buzzard told Fox & Friends First co-host Todd Piro. "I'm giving them everything I've got, too."

Buzzard added that he was initially apprehensive about how he would be received in the locker room, but his younger teammates have welcomed him with open arms.

"I was really wondering, 'How are they going to handle… a 47-year-old guy showing up?'" he said. "Are they going to receive me? Are they going to accept me? Will they try to go easy on me? Will they try to attack me? And they've been incredible."

Buzzard said his top goal is to "go the distance" and make it through the entire season. The Jaguars will open the 2026 season on Saturday against College of the Redwoods.

articles.title: Mamadou Sarr, el descarte de Xabi Alonso que apunta a ser el central fichado por la Real
articles.standfirst: Es un central de sólo 20 años y 1.94 metros, que no cuenta para el ex técnico txuriurdin y que parece que va a ser el elegido para reforzar esa posición en la plantilla de Matarazzo
articles.summary: Es un central de sólo 20 años y 1.94 metros, que no cuenta para el ex técnico txuriurdin y que parece que va a ser el elegido para reforzar esa posición en la plantilla de Matarazzo
articles.body: Mamadou Sarr, central de sólo 20 años y 1,94 metros que no entra en los planes de Xabi Alonso para su Chelsea, parece que va a ser finalmente el jugador que llegue a la Real Sociedad para reforzar esa posición, en la que el club txuriurdin no ha conseguido cerrar varias operaciones que ha intentado durante el verano. Sarr se formó en las categorías inferiores del Olympique de Lyon y, tras una cesión en el Molenbeck belga, recaló en el Estrasburgo de la Ligue 1 en el verano de 2024, donde su gran rendimiento pese a contar con tan sólo 19 años. Un año más tarde el Chelsea pagó por el 10 millones de euros, jugando la primera parte del pasado curso aún a préstamo en el Estrasburgo, siendo recuperado por el club inglés al final del mercado de invierno, aunque apenas contaron con él en la segunda parte de la temporada. El nombre de Sarr lo desveló hace unos días Santi Aouna, el mismo periodista que dio la información al detalle de las negociaciones rotas con Nayef Aguerd y hoy El Diario Vasco afirma que el acuerdo para su llegada a San Sebastián estaría prácticamente cerrado. La noticia llega apenas unas horas después de que Jokin Aperribay y Erik Bretos viajasen a Brasil para intentar, sin éxito, le contratación de Jonathan Jesus. La incorporación de este central que en unos días, el próximo 29 de agosto, cumplirá sólo  21 años, es de riesgo en la Real si tenemos en cuenta que parece que en el club no ven aún preparado a Jon Pacheco, con casi 26 años, y tampoco consideran que se puede apostar ya por Luken Beitia y Kazunari Kita, los centrales que tan buena campaña hicieron el curso pasado con el Sanse.

articles.title: Los deberes del Sevilla en la última semana del mercado de fichajes
articles.standfirst: García Plaza reclama más efectivos para afrontar con garantías el curso pese al arranque
articles.summary: García Plaza reclama más efectivos para afrontar con garantías el curso pese al arranque
articles.body: El Sevilla se prepara para entrar en la última semana del mercado de fichajes con mucho trabajo todavía por delante. El seis de seis con el que ha arrancado LaLiga ha dado tranquilidad en lo deportivo y ha permitido detectar algunos brotes verdes en el proyecto, pero no cambia la hoja de ruta de una Dirección Deportiva que afronta unos últimos días frenéticos. Después de un verano marcado por los problemas económicos, los ajustes salariales y una larga operación salida, toca terminar de aligerar la plantilla y, sobre todo, reforzarla. El club se ha visto obligado a apretarse muchísimo el cinturón. La delicada situación económica ha condicionado prácticamente cada movimiento y ha convertido la reducción del coste de la plantilla en una prioridad absoluta. El Sevilla ha dado ya 15 bajas durante el verano y en algunas operaciones incluso ha tenido que asumir parte de los salarios de los futbolistas que abandonaban Nervión para poder desbloquear sus salidas, atascadas desde hace mucho tiempo. Pero el trabajo no está terminado. Rubén Vargas, Pedrosa y Cardoso son ahora algunos de los nombres que centran la atención. El lateral catalán y Cardoso figuran entre los descartes y el club busca una solución para ambos, mientras que el caso de Vargas tiene una dimensión diferente: su marcha podría convertirse en la llave que permita acelerar varias de las operaciones pendientes. El Sevilla pretende ingresar alrededor de 15 millones de euros por Vargas, cuyo principal pretendiente es el Olympiacos de José Luis Mendilibar. Una venta en esas cantidades supondría un importante balón de oxígeno económico por la plusvalía generada y ampliaría significativamente el margen de maniobra para afrontar las incorporaciones que necesita la plantilla. También está pendiente el futuro de Marcao. El central brasileño tiene propuestas sobre la mesa y medita qué hacer, aunque su posible salida abriría otro 'problema' deportivo en una posición que ya preocupa a Luis García Plaza. El entrenador ha señalado en varias ocasiones que dispone únicamente de tres centrales y considera escasos los efectivos para afrontar una temporada larga. El otro futbolista con mercado es Agoumé. El centrocampista parecía contar con una propuesta procedente de Arabia Saudí que no ha terminado de concretarse, aunque a día de hoy tampoco parece que le seduzca la posibilidad de marcharse. Su situación es diferente a la de los descartes: tiene cartel y podría generar un ingreso relevante, pero su salida obligaría también a replantear la planificación deportiva. Después de tantas salidas llega la segunda parte de los deberes: fichar. En el Sevilla esperan concretar al menos tres incorporaciones antes del cierre del mercado. Hay dos posiciones consideradas indispensables: un centrocampista y un delantero. Dos refuerzos que deben elevar el nivel de una plantilla que ha comenzado bien el campeonato, pero que sigue siendo corta en varias demarcaciones. A ellos podría sumarse un extremo. Su llegada dependerá principalmente de lo que ocurra con Vargas. Si finalmente el internacional suizo abandona Nervión, el Sevilla tendría que acudir al mercado para buscar un sustituto y añadir una tercera incorporación a las dos consideradas prioritarias. Y todavía podría quedar espacio para alguna sorpresa... La posición de central está bajo vigilancia y las reiteradas reclamaciones de García Plaza por contar únicamente con tres especialistas (además de Marcao, claro) hacen que no pueda descartarse un movimiento de última hora. Mucho más si el brasileño termina aceptando alguna de las propuestas que maneja. El buen comienzo liguero ha permitido afrontar esta recta final desde una posición mucho más cómoda. Seis puntos de seis posibles son el mejor colchón para un equipo todavía en construcción. Los primeros partidos han dejado señales positivas, pero también han mostrado las carencias propias de una plantilla corta y pendiente de retoques importantes. El Sevilla ha dedicado buena parte del verano a adelgazar una plantilla que económicamente no podía sostener. Quince bajas, acuerdos complejos y operaciones en las que incluso ha tenido que seguir pagando parte de los salarios para facilitar salidas. Ahora queda completar la transformación. Vender a Vargas, encontrar acomodo a los descartes y cerrar como mínimo un centrocampista y un delantero, con el extremo y el central pendientes de cómo se desarrollen las salidas.

articles.title: El Valencia hace oficial la cesión de Kayne Van Oevelen
articles.standfirst: El portero del Ipswich Town espera ser inscrito en la Liga para poder entrar en la convocatoria del partido contra el Betis
articles.summary: El portero del Ipswich Town espera ser inscrito en la Liga para poder entrar en la convocatoria del partido contra el Betis
articles.body: El Valencia ha anunciado oficialmente el fichaje de Kayne Van Oevelen, que se incorpora al conjunto de Mestalla en calidad de cedido procedente del Ipswich Town hasta el final de la temporada 2026-27. El acuerdo no contempla opción de compra y refuerza una de las posiciones que la dirección deportiva consideraba prioritarias en el actual mercado estival. A sus 23 años, el guardameta neerlandés llega para competir por un puesto en la portería valencianista junto a Stole Dimitrievski y su incorporación supone además el sexto movimiento del club durante el presente verano. De hecho, el Valencia espera que el trámite para la inscripción en la Liga se cierre mañana y podría entrar en la convocatoria. Van Oevelen aterrizó en Valencia el domingo 23 de agosto para completar los trámites previos a la oficialización de la operación. A su llegada al aeropuerto de Manises, el portero mostró su satisfacción por incorporarse a la entidad blanquinegra.  El meta nacido en Zaandam se formó en el fútbol neerlandés y dio el salto al primer plano con el Volendam, donde llamó la atención por sus condiciones físicas, especialmente sus casi dos metros de estatura, su dominio del juego aéreo y su capacidad para ocupar espacios bajo palos. Durante la pasada temporada disputó 32 encuentros ligueros y se consolidó como una de las apariciones más destacadas de la Eredivisie, despertando el interés de varios clubes europeos. El Valencia ya había seguido de cerca al guardameta cuando militaba en el Volendam e incluso exploró su incorporación en propiedad antes de que el Ipswich Town cerrara su traspaso este verano. Apenas unas semanas después de llegar al conjunto inglés, la falta de perspectivas inmediatas de minutos en la Premier League abrió la puerta a una cesión que finalmente se ha concretado con destino Mestalla.

articles.title: Week 0 what to watch: UNC looks for revenge against TCU, NC State-Virginia open with ACC matchup
articles.summary: This year's Week Zero slate features eight FBS games and several compelling storylines to kick off the year.
articles.body:
The offseason is over, and college football is back … for a few teams, at least.

As in recent years, the regular season will start with a "Week Zero" handful of games. The vast majority of FBS teams will begin play a week later.

Even with an eight-game slate on tap for Saturday, Aug. 29, there is still plenty to look for as the college football season begins.

The day begins as North Carolina takes on TCU in Dublin, Ireland. This will be the official start of Year 2 in the Bill Belichick era at UNC, and he will be looking to improve on the disappointing 4-8 2025 campaign that included a 48-14 blowout loss to TCU in the season opener.

Yahoo Sports introduces a new era with College Fantasy Football: Sign up and get ready to play!

Sean McVay can't comprehend players going from NFL camps back to college: 'I feel like I took a freakin' gummy'

Akron announces its 'Offensive Coordinator of the Game,' who will help Joe Moorhead script opening drive vs. Robert Morris

Saturday's slate concludes as Memphis heads west to take on UNLV. Charles Huff will debut as the Tigers' new head coach after going 7-5 with Southern Miss last season. The Rebels are not only preseason favorites in the Mountain West, but also many analysts' choice to get the Group of Six College Football Playoff spot.

Here are the five biggest games in Week Zero:

UNC overhauled its quarterback room this offseason. Last year, Max Johnson played in four games while Gio Lopez saw action in 11 games. Johnson is now the starting quarterback at Georgia Southern, while Lopez stayed in the ACC and took his talents to Wake Forest.

The Tar Heels have named Billy Edwards Jr. as their starting quarterback . Edwards began his collegiate career at Maryland, spending three seasons with the Terrapins. He transferred to Wisconsin last season, but played in only two games after dealing with a knee injury.

The Horned Frogs blew out UNC in Week 1 last year and finished the season with an overall 9-4 record, but they went 5-4 in Big 12 play. It did mark back-to-back nine-win seasons for head coach Sonny Dykes, and the Horned Frogs have won at least nine games in three of the four seasons he has been at the helm. They need a strong start to the year and would love to go into the Oct. 3 matchup against BYU with a 4-0 record and momentum.

TCU will be led by Harvard transfer quarterback Jaden Craig after Josh Hoover left for Indiana in the offseason. Craig is more of a pocket passer and threw for 2,869 yards, 25 touchdowns and 7 interceptions last season as the Crimson finished 9-2 in their FCS season.

One preseason AP-ranked team will see action in Week Zero as the No. 14 Trojans host San Jose State. USC is coming off a 9-4 season in its second year in the Big Ten. The Trojans are still searching for their first College Football Playoff berth with Lincoln Riley as their head coach.

Jayden Maiava played in all 13 games for USC last season. He finished with 3,711 passing yards, 24 touchdowns and 10 interceptions. The QB doesn't rush often, but did tally six rushing touchdowns.

USC's big question will be who steps up at wide receiver after the departure of Makai Lemon (drafted 20th overall by the Philadelphia Eagles ) and Ja'Kobi Lane (third-round pick by the Baltimore Ravens ). The teammates combined for 1,901 yards and 15 touchdowns last season.

San Jose State had a disappointing 3-9 season last year with a 2-6 record in the Mountain West. The Spartans named transfer quarterback Luke Weaver as their starter against USC. Weaver played in just five games at Hawaii last year and finished with 628 passing yards, 6 touchdowns and 3 interceptions. He won the job over redshirt freshman Robert McDaniel and true freshman Daniel Rolovich.

There are only two Week Zero matchups between conference opponents, and NC State facing Virginia is easily the bigger one.

The Wolfpack finished last season 8-5 after beating Memphis in the Gasparilla Bowl. NC State will have a familiar face under center as CJ Bailey is back for his third year as the starter.

So far, over two years, he has tallied 5,518 passing yards, 42 passing touchdowns, 19 interceptions, 494 rushing yards and 11 rushing touchdowns in 25 games. One thing to watch here is the Wolfpack's running game. Hollywood Smothers transferred to Texas, and redshirt sophomore Jayden Scott is expected to take over in the backfield.

Virginia made it all the way to the ACC championship last season. The Cavaliers fell to Duke 27-20 in overtime, but picked up a win in the Gator Bowl to finish 11-3 — their most wins in program history .

UVA will start transfer QB Beau Pribula in Week Zero; he played in 10 games for Missouri last season. Pribula threw for 1,941 yards with 11 touchdowns and 9 interceptions. He also ran for 297 yards and six more touchdowns on the ground.

The Seminoles will open their 2026 season at home against New Mexico State in a non-conference matchup. Florida State is looking to rebound after a disappointing 5-7 finish last year. The Noles only managed two conference wins, beating Wake Forest and Clemson.

Former FSU quarterback Tommy Castellanos is in the transfer portal; the Seminoles will be led by transfer QB Ashton Daniels. After spending three years at Stanford, Daniels transferred to Auburn last year. He played in only four games and finished with just 797 passing yards, 3 touchdowns and 2 interceptions.

Mike Norvell has been Florida State's head coach for six seasons. The team has gone 38-34 in that span, and he enters this year firmly on the hot seat .

New Mexico State started last season 3-2, but then lost five consecutive games. When the dust settled, the Aggies finished the year 4-8 and went 2-6 in Conference USA play. New Mexico State will turn to Trey Hedden as its starting quarterback. Hedden transferred to the Aggies from Furman. Last year, he had 2,967 yards, 17 touchdowns and 13 interceptions for the Paladins.

After back-to-back 10+ win seasons under Ryan Silverfield, the Tigers took a step back last season, finishing 8-5 and going 4-4 in conference play. Silverfield left for Arkansas, and now Huff begins a new era at Memphis.

The Tigers have had a lengthy quarterback battle between Marcus Stokes and former five-star QB Air Noland . Stokes transferred to Memphis from West Florida (Division II). Noland spent one season with Ohio State and last season with South Carolina. He's appeared in just two games and is 2-of-3 passing for 13 yards.

UNLV is a popular pick to make the CFP as the Group of Six representative. Part of that stems from belief in Dan Mullen's system after his team finished 10-4 last year.

The Rebels also have an ongoing quarterback battle between Jackson Arnold (who transferred in from Auburn) and Alex Orji, a former Michigan QB who played in three games for UNLV last season before suffering season-ending injuries. Arnold played in 10 games for Auburn last year before being benched for poor performance. He finished with 1,309 yards, 6 touchdowns and 2 interceptions.

articles.title: 10 biggest storylines entering the 2026 college football season
articles.summary: How will Lane Kiffin do in his first season at LSU? Will the Big Ten continue its dominant run with another title? What's the future of the CFP? Here's what...
articles.body:
With the start of the 2026 college football season officially now just days away, it's a perfect time to refresh yourself on some of the biggest themes that will dominate the season.

Here are 10 of the biggest storylines as we enter the third season of the 12-team College Football Playoff era.

If we're counting recent playoff titles as the ultimate barometer, the Big Ten currently has the upper hand. The league has won the last three national championships with three different teams — Michigan, Ohio State and Indiana.

Will one of those three teams win the title again to extend the streak to four? Can Oregon be the team to make it four in a row?

Perhaps tellingly, AP voters are backing the Big Ten early this season. All 69 first-place votes in the preseason poll went to Big Ten teams . Not a single SEC team received a first-place vote, though the league had seven teams in the top 13 and nine teams in the top 25.

The SEC again has an argument that it's the deeper conference in 2026. Last season, seven teams finished with two or fewer conference losses. The Big Ten had just five such teams and only one other with three conference losses.

But the arguments over conference depth are pretty, well, shallow when one league is hogging all the national titles. The Big Ten's claim to being the best conference in college football will only get stronger with another championship this season.

The 12-team playoff is back for a third season and yes, it looks different once again.

The two main changes prevent repeats of what happened at the end of the 2025 season. Thanks to the rule that put the top five conference champions in the field, ACC champion Duke missed out on the playoff in favor of James Madison.

That rule is gone. Instead, all four power conference champions are guaranteed a spot in the field while the fifth spot for a champion will go to the highest-ranked Group of Six team. The odds of two Group of Six teams getting into the field again are extremely low.

Additionally, Notre Dame is guaranteed a spot in the field if it's in the top 12 in the final CFP rankings. A year ago, the Irish were the first team out of the field when Miami jumped them in the final rankings. But Notre Dame was still in the top 12 even with Miami ahead. Had the rule been in effect in 2025, Notre Dame would have still made the postseason and Miami, which made the national title game, would have been left out.

What will playoff look like in the future?

The rivalry between the SEC and the Big Ten is going to continue throughout the 2026 season in playoff discussions too. The two conferences have all the power when it comes to figuring out the future format of the postseason. And they haven't figured out how to come to an agreement on it.

The Big Ten initially proposed a format that would guarantee it and the SEC more spots than the other power conferences. That idea went nowhere. Now, the Big Ten is in favor of expanding the playoff to 24 teams and has even offered to scrap the Big Ten title game if the playoff doubles in size.

Additionally, a 16-team playoff has been floated with four play-in games ahead of a playoff format that looks like the current 12-team iteration. Does that have any support?

Like last season, the future of the CFP is going to be hotly contested. And guess what? If there's no consensus, the 12-team playoff is going to return for 2027.

After leading Ole Miss to the College Football Playoff in 2025, Lane Kiffin couldn't resist LSU and agreed to join the Tigers before the postseason began. By now, you know that Ole Miss didn't want Kiffin coaching the Rebels in the playoff while also working at a bitter rival and promoted defensive coordinator Pete Golding.

Now, Ole Miss enters the 2026 season with similar national title odds and a higher preseason ranking in the AP Top 25 as Kiffin overhauled LSU's roster. In are former Arizona State QB Sam Leavitt, ex-Colorado OT Jordan Seaton and former Ole Miss edge rusher Princewill Umanmielen, among others.

After firing Brian Kelly following a 24-point home loss to Texas A&M, the Tigers finished 7-6 in 2025. It was the school's sixth-straight season with at least three losses since an undefeated run to the national championship in 2019.

No one rational is asking Kiffin to lead the Tigers to an undefeated season in 2026. But as Ole Miss is again a playoff contender, the Rebels are the bar in his first season in Baton Rouge. Oh, LSU heads to Oxford in Week 3, too. It's hard to think of a bigger revenge game for a home fan base in quite some time.

What will coaching carousel look like in 2026?

The firings of Kelly and James Franklin during the middle of the 2025 season were the start of an especially active coaching cycle. More than 30 FBS schools hired new coaches ahead of the 2026 season.

The coaching carousel can't spin as fast during and after the 2026 season , right?

We can't rule anything out after last year — no one saw Franklin's midseason firing coming at this time a year ago — but all signs point to fewer coaching changes. Coaches like Florida State's Mike Norvell, Wisconsin's Luke Fickell and Baylor's Dave Aranda enter the season with pressure for their teams to put up winning seasons, but with 22 power conference coaches entering either their first or second seasons at their current schools, there likely won't be as much action.

The Pac-12 is reborn with six new members

After two years with just Oregon State and Washington State as its members, the Pac-12 added six teams ahead of the 2026 season.

Most of those teams came from the Mountain West, as Boise State, Colorado State, Fresno State, San Diego State and Utah State came over. Texas State joined from the Sun Belt.

This version of the Pac-12 won't be mistaken for a power conference. It barely has enough teams for a conference championship game. Since there are only eight schools in the league, each team plays another twice in the regular season and those matchups will be finalized before the end of the season.

But despite its limited numbers, this is a league that should compete with the American to be the best non-power conference in football this season. Boise State is one of the Group of Six favorites to make the playoff, and a team like Fresno State or even San Diego State could even make a case for the postseason with a Pac-12 title.

What will North Dakota State do at the top level?

The Mountain West went out and got one of the most successful football programs of the 2000s to help replenish its ranks after the Pac-12 took five of its members.

Longtime FCS powerhouse North Dakota State is now at the top level of college football and no one should be surprised if the Bison compete for the Mountain West title. After all, this is a team that has won nine games against FBS schools over the past 21 seasons.

The conference schedule isn't inviting; the Bison have to travel to Air Force, UNLV, New Mexico and Hawaii. Those are four of the best remaining programs in the Mountain West. But the Bison should get at least one win in those games, and the non-conference schedule is extremely easy. Thanks to an NCAA rule change, North Dakota State is eligible to go to a bowl this season and it'll be a shock if the Bison aren't bowl eligible.

Punts will look a bit different in 2026 and many coaches weren't happy about it. Thanks to an offseason rule change , teams who line up to punt will now have to have at least five players wearing Nos. 50-79 on the line of scrimmage. If they don't, certain conditions will need to be met and any players who are on the line as part of a numbering exception cannot shift before the snap.

The Big Ten's coaches were all apparently against the rule and Iowa's Kirk Ferentz, the punt-friendliest head coach in college football, said there was "no compelling reason" for the rule change.

The rules are likely to prevent teams from designing clever punt fake concepts to confuse their opponents. But let's be real, we don't need fewer punt fakes. We need more of them. Could the changes lead to more blocked punts if returning teams are no longer as scared of a fake as they would have been?

Which school will have a first-year coach bounce?

With 17 power conference coaches in their first year at their new schools, there are bound to be at least a few teams that make a major leap from a disappointing 2025. Who are the likeliest candidates?

After a disaster of a 1-11 season in 2025, Oklahoma State hired North Texas coach Eric Morris. Former UNT QB Drew Mestemaker is now in Stillwater, along with prolific RB Caleb Hawkins. A Week 2 game against Oregon will likely be a loss, but the Cowboys don't play either BYU or Utah and also avoid Arizona. A bowl game is very possible.

UCLA is also in line to improve after a 3-9 season in 2025. The Bruins hired Bob Chesney from James Madison, and RB Wayne Knight followed him to Los Angeles along with a bunch of other former Dukes. A stronger running game is key for UCLA; QB Nico Iamaleava was the team's leading rusher in 2025.

It's time to get used to corporate logos on your favorite team's jersey

If you're a soccer fan, you're probably numb to the sponsor names and logos that are commonplace on the front of jerseys in nearly every league across the globe. If you're a baseball fan, you're probably already glossing over the corporate logos on the sleeve of MLB jerseys, though the helmet sponsorships in the postseason are still a bit weird.

How long will it take to get used to similar branding in college sports? The 2026-27 school year is the first where schools can sell corporate logo space on their jerseys and numerous programs across the country have already inked seven-figure deals. Heck, the Big 12 even has a deal with Monster to plaster the energy drink company's logo on every jersey and playing surface.

The patches are going to look out of place at first, but as the weeks go on, we're inevitably going to get used to them. It stinks that corporatism has invaded another part of college football, but it was also the natural progression as schools turn over every leaf looking for revenue-generating opportunities.

Tim Polasek's North Dakota State team has made the jump to the FBS level. (Justin Tafoya via Getty Images)
Oklahoma State hired Eric Morris after firing Mike Gundy three games into the 2025 season. (Stacy Revere via Getty Images)

articles.title: Manchester City transfer news: Enzo Maresca's side agree deal for Palmeiras winger Allan Elias
articles.summary: Manchester City agree to sign winger Allan Elias from Palmeiras in a deal worth up to £34.2m.
articles.body:
Manchester City have agreed to sign winger Allan Elias from Palmeiras in a deal worth up to £34.2m.

The 22-year-old Brazilian will come in as a replacement for compatriot Savinho, who looks set to join Tottenham .

City are set to pay a fixed fee of £32m, plus £2.2m in add-ons, and a medical is scheduled to take place in the coming days.

They remain in advanced talks to sell Egypt forward Omar Marmoush to Spurs, and sources with knowledge of the situation say there is a "good chance" the deal gets completed before the 1 September transfer deadline.

Discussions are ongoing between the two clubs and there are some details yet to be agreed.

Midfielder Nico Gonzalez may also depart Etihad Stadium before the end of the transfer window, with strong interest in the Spaniard from Newcastle .

articles.title: Cruz Azul quiere delantero para sacar de la crisis a Joel Huiqui
articles.standfirst: La Máquina hilvana derrotas y se rezaga en el Apertura 2026
articles.summary: La Máquina hilvana derrotas y se rezaga en el Apertura 2026
articles.body: Joel Huiqui se mantuvo invicto durante sus primeros 10 juegos a cargo de Cruz Azul, cuando tomó el lugar de Nicolás Larcamón en la jornada 17 del torneo anterior y salió campeón en sus primeros siete partidos como entrenador. Y comenzó la nueva temporada de la Liga MX con tres triunfos, donde sumó otro título con el Campeón de Campeones, pero ahí llegaron los problemas y la primera crisis. Desde que perdió su primer partido frente al Atlante en la jornada 3, La Máquina de Huiqui ha perdido cuatro de sus últimos seis duelos y quedó eliminado en la Leagues Cup al caer con el Chicago Fire de Robert Lewandowski. En el Apertura 2026 ha perdido los últimos tres juegos. Por ahora, en nueve partidos oficiales este semestre han marcado 15 goles, con José Paradela y Nico Ibáñez como los más goleadores con cuatro y tres anotaciones cada uno, pero desde hace varios torneos han buscado un delantero que no han podido fichar. Primero fue Miguel Borja en enero, hoy con el América, y volvieron a explorar en Argentina con Alex Arce y parece que tampoco lo ficharán. El representante del paraguayo de 31 años, Miguel Gareppe, reconoció para Radio Monumental que Cruz Azul preguntó por Arce, pero no prosperó el tema ya que La Máquina no tiene plaza libre de extranjero. El futuro de Arce parece que estará en la Serie A de Brasil, ya que el Internacional de Porto Alegre estaría cerca de ficharlo por unos 3 millones de dólares por el atacante del Independiente de Rivadavia, donde ha marcado 47 goles en 74 duelos.

articles.standfirst: Hasta cinco jugadores fueron dados de alta en la competición en la tarde de este lunes
articles.summary: Hasta cinco jugadores fueron dados de alta en la competición en la tarde de este lunes
articles.body: De manera relámpago, el Levante inscribió hasta cinco jugadores para poder estar disponibles en la lista de Luís Castro para enfrentarse a Club Atlético Osasuna, correspondiente a la segunda jornada de liga. La salida de Kareem Tunde al West Bromwich Albion, aún sin ser oficial, facilitó la difícil situación que el club del barrio de Orriols está teniendo para poder dar de alta a las diferentes incorporaciones de este mercado de fichajes. El primero que la propia competición mostró fue al central austriaco Ifeanyi Ndukwe, que no consiguió debutar en competición oficial a causa de tan solo ejercitarse con el grupo durante dos sesiones de entrenamiento. Así mismo, otro de los jugadores que también figuran en LaLiga es Dani Requena, aunque tampoco pudo lucir la camiseta granota en el Sadar. Por otro lado, dos de las incorporaciones de este verano y que también fueron inscritos en la previa ante Osasuna fueron Thiago Fernández, que fue titular en la segunda fecha del torneo, y Hugo Sotelo, aunque tan solo estuvo presente durante dos minutos del envite. El caso más llamativo de todos fue el de Musuayi. El atacante belga fue dado de alta e incluso, inicialmente figuraba en la lista de convocados del entrenador luso aunque, un cambio de última hora, debido a una sanción del pasado lo apartó definitivamente del choque.

articles.title: Ex-Liverpool star Fabinho reunited with Mohamed Salah at Trabzonspor
articles.summary: Fabinho joined Saudi Arabia’s Al-Ittihad in 2023, where he won the league after his five-year stint at Liverpool.
articles.body:
Brazil ⁠midfielder Fabinho has ⁠signed a two-year deal with Trabzonspor, the Turkish Super Lig football side has announced, and will link up with ⁠former Liverpool teammate Mohamed Salah .

The 32-year-old midfielder will receive a 2.6-million-euro ($3.03m) guaranteed fee and a 1.4-million-euro ($1.63m) signing ⁠fee per season, according to a Turkish stock exchange filing made by the team on Monday.

“An agreement has been reached for a two-year contract with … Fabinho, who is currently in free status,” Trabzonspor posted on ‌X.

Fabinho joined Saudi Arabia’s Al-Ittihad in 2023 and helped the team win the domestic league after his five-year stint at Liverpool.

“A really special feeling to be playing with Salah again … I had the opportunity to play with him for five years in Liverpool. He is a person whom I respect a lot both for ⁠what he has done and what he ⁠will do,” Fabinho said after arriving at Trabzon airport earlier on Monday.

Looking to reignite his chemistry with 34-year-old Salah, Fabinho said: “I will always try to do the ⁠best I can with whatever ability I have.

“Along with the experience and leadership that come from ⁠playing for so many years, I will ⁠always try to help my teammates.”

Fabinho made 219 appearances for Liverpool, helping it win the Premier League, Champions League, FA Cup, League Cup, Club World Cup and UEFA Super Cup ‌titles.

Egypt forward Salah joined Trabzonspor as a free agent earlier this month.

Trabzonspor finished third in the Turkish top flight last season, and take on Hungary’s Ferencvaros on Thursday in the second leg of their Europa League playoff tie, trailing 1-0.
